paper_id: He and Liu - 2007 - Supporting VCR in Peer-to-Peer Video-On-Demand
title: Supporting VCR in Peer-to-Peer Video-On-Demand
motivation: VOD用户频繁使用VCR控制导致高延迟或服务器过载
problem_framing: 如何预测VCR操作中用户将跳转到的视频片段

evaluation_criteria: 累计命中率、并发用户数、启动延迟

provide short startup latencies and good performance
thinking_moves: 观察到VOD用户行为的非连续性特征
